case_number: 2024 INSC 893; Writ Petition (Civil) No 645 of 2020, Writ Petition (Civil) No 1467 of 2020
summary: Challenge to insertion of 'socialist' and 'secular' in Constitution Preamble via 42nd Amendment; retrospectivity; Constituent Assembly intent; Emergency-era enactment critique; Preamble amendment permissible under Article 368; secularism established as basic structure via Kesavananda Bharati; socialist interpreted as welfare commitment without economic restriction; historical acceptance negates delay-challenge; dismissal on lack of merit after 44 years.
legal_provisions_cited: Kesavananda Bharati v. State of Kerala
S R Bommai vs Union of India
final_judgment: Writ petitions dismissed with costs; Miscellaneous Application No 835 of 2024 allowed; intervention applications dismissed.
